correctness.rationale: The supremum is reduced rigorously to vertex pairs by separate convexity on the polygonal unit ball. Dihedral symmetry leaves five separations, each norm expression is derived from explicit supporting facets, and exact polynomial comparisons produce the unique envelope switch m_*=(4-sqrt(2))/7. The bundled exact Q(sqrt(2)) checker verifies support breakpoints, distances, identities, ordering, continuity and endpoints without floating-point assumptions.

value.rationale: The regular octagon is a standard non-Hilbert benchmark for Banach geometric constants, and exact constants on it are an active literature theme. The claim gives a complete parameter profile of a recently introduced invariant, exposes a nontrivial change of extremizing geometry, and recovers the classical modified von Neumann-Jordan endpoint. It is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary finite slice or a routine numerical recomputation.
